mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT agent_id) FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND agent_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
SELECT COALESCE(AVG(latency_ms), 0) FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND usage_date = CURDATE() AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1

SELECT COALESCE(a.agent_name, '未知 Agent') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM token_usage tu LEFT JOIN agent a ON tu.agent_id = a.id WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY tu.agent_id, a.agent_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT COALESCE(app.app_name, '未关联应用') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM token_usage tu LEFT JOIN application app ON tu.application_id = app.id WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.usage_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 DAY) GROUP BY tu.application_id, app.app_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT CONCAT(LPAD(HOUR(MIN(created_at)), 2, '0'), ':00') AS time_label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY HOUR(created_at) ORDER BY HOUR(created_at)

SELECT COALESCE(latency_ms, 0) FROM ( SELECT latency_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS row_num, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND usage_date = CURDATE() AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE row_num = GREATEST(1, CEILING(total_count * 0.95)) LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(latency_ms, 0) FROM ( SELECT latency_ms, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms) AS row_num, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count FROM token_usage WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND usage_date = CURDATE() AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL ) ranked WHERE row_num = GREATEST(1, CEILING(total_count * 0.99)) LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(a.agent_name, '未知 Agent') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM token_usage tu LEFT JOIN agent a ON tu.agent_id = a.id WHERE tu.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND tu.success = 0 AND tu.usage_date = CURDATE() GROUP BY tu.agent_id, a.agent_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 5
